text.formatted:
When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

|   Sorcerer Level | Spells                                                              |
|------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
|                3 | Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath |
|                5 | Fear, Fly                                                   |
|                7 | Arcane Eye, Charm Monster                                   |
|                9 | Legend Lore, Summon Dragon                                  |
